description: This file defines data models and a fetcher class for Benzinga analyst search data, including query parameters, data structures, and methods for data extraction and transformation.

classes.name: BenzingaAnalystSearchQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Benzinga analyst search API requests, including filtering options and validation.

classes.name: BenzingaAnalystSearchData
classes.description: Represents individual analyst search data entries with various statistical and rating metrics.

classes.name: BenzingaAnalystSearchFetcher
classes.description: Handles data fetching and transformation for Benzinga analyst search, including API request and response processing.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a BenzingaAnalystSearchQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw analyst search data from Benzinga API, handling response validation.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into a list of BenzingaAnalystSearchData instances.
